doc: League items Fiddlesticks builds, offered three at a time when a boss dies (max 6 owned). id = League item id: name, description, stats and icon come from the player's League client (items.json, in the client's language). Stats from the item's lines apply: ability power, ability haste, magic penetration (% then flat), health (added to his Elden Ring max HP), armor (takes 100/(100+armor) off damage taken), movement speed %; mana does not (he has none). An item can have several rows, one per passive; enemies count as champions. effect: burn (share of max HP per second for 3 s on ability hits), burn_ap (AP share per burning enemy), slow (ability hits, 1 s), ap_mult, low_hp_mult (magic damage on targets under 40% HP), r_haste (Crowstorm ability haste), combat_dmg (damage share per second in combat, up to combat_dmg_max), omnivamp (heal share of damage while combat_dmg is at its max), ap_from_hp (AP per item health), hatefog (magic damage per second for 3 s on targets of his R; hatefog_ap per AP; hatefog_mr magic resistance off), grievous (share of their healing cut for 3 s after his magic damage), spelldance_ms (movement speed share for 4 s after magic damage), stasis (Zhonya, T), pen_fx (void burst where penetration cuts through), none.

rows.note: Liandry's Torment, Torment: abilities burn 2% max HP per second for 3 s
Liandry's Torment, Suffering: +2% damage per second in combat
Liandry's Torment, Suffering: up to 6%
Blackfire Torch, Baleful Blaze: abilities burn for 3 s (League gives no number; 1.5% max HP per second)
Blackfire Torch, Blackfire: +4% AP per burning enemy
Malignance, Scorn: +20 ultimate ability haste
Malignance, Hatefog: R hits burn the ground under them for 3 s, magic damage per second (League: 60 + 5% AP)
Malignance, Hatefog: per AP
Malignance, Hatefog: magic resistance taken off (League: 10)
Rabadon's Deathcap, Magical Opus: +30% total AP
Void Staff: 40% magic penetration from its stat line (no passive); pen_fx = the void burst on his ability hits
Shadowflame, Cinderbloom: magic damage crits targets under 40% HP for +20%
Rylai's Crystal Scepter, Rimefrost: abilities slow 30% for 1 s
Zhonya's Hourglass, Time Stop: T = stasis while League's Zhonya sound plays (3 s, creator's request; value s if the sound is missing)
Cosmic Drive, Spelldance: magic damage gives movement speed for 4 s (League gives no number; +10%)
Morellonomicon, Grievous Wounds: magic damage cuts the target's healing 40% for 3 s
Riftmaker, Void Corruption: +2% damage per second in combat
Riftmaker, Void Corruption: up to 8%
Riftmaker, Void Corruption: omnivamp at full stacks (League gives no number; 8%)
Riftmaker, Void Infusion: 2% of the items' health as AP
